t2120.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Zayd ibn Thābit al-Anṣārī al-Najjārī, Abū Saʿīd and Abū Khārija, as a well-known Companion who wrote the revelation; Masrūq said he was among those firmly grounded in knowledge; he died in 45, 48, or after 50.
as: he was among those firmly grounded in knowledge
النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم, quoted by al-Mizzī
Zayd ibn Thābit knows inheritance shares best among them.
غلب زيد بن ثابت الناس على اثنين: الفرائض، والقرآن
Zayd surpassed people in two areas, inheritance law and the Qurʾān.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by al-Mizzī
What a fine young man he is.
إني قدمت المدينة، فوجدت زيد بن ثابت من الراسخين في العلم
I came to Medina and found Zayd ibn Thābit firmly grounded in knowledge.
من سره أن يعلم كيف ذهاب العلم فهكذا ذهاب العلم، والله، لقد دفن اليوم علم كثير
Anyone wishing to know how knowledge departs can see it here. By God, much knowledge was buried today.
His merits and virtues were very numerous.
أبو بكر, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
You are an intelligent young man whom we do not suspect.
ثابت بن عبيد, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
ما رأيت رجلا أفكه في بيته ولا أوقر في مجلسه من زيد
I never saw anyone more cheerful at home or more dignified in his gathering than Zayd.
النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
Zayd knows inheritance shares best among you.
Ibn ʿAbbās, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
لقد علم المحفوظون من أصحاب محمد أن زيد بن ثابت كان من الراسخين في العلم
Muḥammad’s Companions who preserved the reports knew Zayd was firmly grounded in knowledge.
أبو هريرة, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
اليوم مات حبر هذه الأمة، وعسى الله أن يجعل في ابن عباس منه خلفا
Today the scholar of this community died. May God make Ibn ʿAbbās his successor in this.
قبيصة, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
كان زيد رأسا بالمدينة في القضاء والفتوى والقراءة والفرائض
Zayd was a leading figure in Medina in judging, legal opinions, recitation and inheritance law.
Zayd was one of the learned Companions.
Masrūq, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
قدمت المدينة فوجدت زيد بن ثابت من الراسخين في العلم
I came to Medina and found Zayd firmly grounded in knowledge.
Mālik ibn Anas, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
كان إمام الناس عندنا بعد عمر بن الخطاب زيد بن ثابت
Zayd was our people’s leading authority after ʿUmar.
ثابت بن عبيد, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
كان زيد بن ثابت من أفكه الناس إذا خلا مع أهله، وأصمتهم إذا جلس مع القوم
Zayd was among the wittiest with his family and the quietest when sitting with others.
وكان أحد فقهاء الصحابة الجلة الفراض
He was among the leading Companion jurists versed in inheritance shares.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
What a fine boy he is.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
Zayd ibn Thābit is the most versed in inheritance among my community.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
What a fine young man he is.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
Zayd is the foremost of you.
وكان من أعلم الصحابة والراسخين في العلم
He was among the most learned Companions and firmly grounded in knowledge.
أبو هريرة, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
اليوم مات حبر هذه الأمة، وعسى الله أن يجعل في ابن عباس منه خلفا
Today the scholar of this community died. May God make Ibn ʿAbbās his successor in this.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
Zayd has learned more of the Qur’an than you.
He was the Companion most knowledgeable about the prescribed inheritance shares.
وكان من أفكه الناس إذا خلا مع أهله، وأزمتهم إذا كان في القوم
He was one of the wittiest in private with his family and among the most reserved in company.

t911.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim al-Azdī, Abū al-Naḍr al-Baṣrī, father of Wahb: trustworthy, but weak in his transmission from Qatādah and prone to errors from memory; of the sixth generation, died 70 AH after confusion.
as: ثقة لكن في حديثه عن قتادة ضعف وله أوهام إذا حدث من حفظه
Trustworthy, but his transmission from Qatādah is weak, and he had errors when narrating from memory.
عليك بجرير بن حازم فاسمع منه
Go to Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim and hear from him.
ما أقربهما، ولكن جرير كان أكثرهما وهما
Jarīr and Abū al-Ashhab are close, though Jarīr made more mistakes.
جرير بن حازم أثبت عندي من قرة بن خالد
I regard Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim as more precise than Qurrah ibn Khālid.
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī, quoted by al-Mizzī
جرير بن حازم، اختلط، وكان له أولاد، أصحاب حديث، فلما أحسوا ذلك منه حجبوه، فلم يسمع أحد منه، في حال اختلاطه شيئا
Jarīr became confused. His sons, who studied hadith, secluded him when they noticed it. No one heard reports from him in that condition.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
He changed a year before he died.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Jarīr’s hadith were better than Abū al-Ashhab’s and more often had connected chains.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ليس له بأس، فقلت: إنه يحدث عن قتادة عن أنس أحاديث مناكير. فقال: ليس بشيء، وهو عن قتادة ضعيف
There is no objection to Jarīr in general. When asked about objectionable reports from Qatādah through Anas, Ibn Maʿīn said his reports from Qatādah are weak.
There is no objection to him.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
جرير بن حازم صدوق، صالح، قدم هو والسري بن يحيى مصر، وجرير بن حازم أحسن حديثا منه، والسري أحلى منه
Jarīr was truthful and upright. He and al-Sarī ibn Yaḥyā came to Egypt. Jarīr’s hadith were better, and al-Sarī was more pleasant.
وهو مستقيم الحديث، صالح فيه، إلا روايته عن قتادة، فإنه يروي عن قتادة أشياء لا تتابع، يرويها غيره، وجرير من ثقات الناس
His hadith are generally sound and acceptable, with an exception for his reports from Qatādah. He gives reports from Qatādah for which there is no corroboration. Jarīr is among the reliable people.
وكان ثقة إلا أنه اختلط في آخر عمره
He was reliable, though he became confused at the end of his life.

t964.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Jumʿa ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Sulamī, Abū Bakr al-Balkhī, as truthful, of the tenth generation, who died in 33 AH; Jumʿa is said to be a nickname for Yaḥyā.
